Name: Slightly Cuter Brown Hair Abigail
Author: OhheyyHannahh
Description:
You will need Content Patcher for this mod. in this mod i have given abigail a more "sun-kissed" look, pink lipstick and super cute brown hair. If your looking to change from purple hair abigail to a different color then try out my mod :) thank you!

Manually download the zip file, then extract the file into your "mods" folder. Then run your game as per usual.

If you enjoy my mods, consider [url=https://ko-fi.com/arlouria]buying me a coffee :)[/url]
